abstract: OBJECTIVE: The objective of this study was to review our experience of laparoscopic (LA) or laparoscopic-assisted pelvic surgery (LAPS) in small infants. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The medical records of 35 patients who underwent an LA or LAPS between January 2007 and June 2010 were studied and 21 patients who were younger than 1 year or whose weight was less than 10 kg were included. Indications, procedures, results, and complications were analyzed. RESULTS: The indications of surgery and procedures done were impalpable undescended testes (7 cases--3 single-stage orchidopexy and 4 Fowler Stephen stage I ligation of testicular vessels), Hirschsprung's disease (HD; 5 cases--all laparoscopic-assisted transanal pull-through), anorectal malformation (ARM; 3 cases--all laparoscopic-assisted pull-through), disorders of sexual differentiation (3 cases--1 herniotomy and 2 gonadal biopsy), sacrococcygeal teratoma (1 case--laparoscopic mobilization of pelvic component and posterior sagittal excision), and ovarian mass (2 cases; laparoscopic oophorectomy). There were 14 males, 4 females, and 3 of indeterminate sex. All procedures could be successfully completed without conversion. There was no anesthesia-related complication or need for postoperative ventilatory support. There were no immediate procedure-related complications. One female child with ARM had rectal mucosal prolapse; 1 HD case had rectovaginal fistula that healed following fecal diversion. The major advantages of laparoscopy in different indications were magnified access into the depth of pelvis and early frozen section biopsies in HD, accurate placement of neoanus in the center of muscle complex in ARM, early ligation of vessels and avoidance of laparotomy in sacrococcygeal teratoma, ease of decision making and better mobilization of vessels in undescended testes, and diagnostic accuracy and therapeutic procedure in ambiguous genitalia. CONCLUSION: Laparoscopic pelvic surgery in small infants is a safe procedure with advantage of magnification, access, and cosmesis.
abstract_ja: 目的：1歳未満または体重10kg未満の乳幼児に対する腹腔鏡下および腹腔鏡補助下骨盤手術の経験を検討した。対象と方法：2007年1月から2010年6月に腹腔鏡下または腹腔鏡補助下骨盤手術を受けた35例の診療記録を調べ、そのうち1歳未満または体重10kg未満の21例を対象とした。適応、術式、転帰、合併症を解析した。結果：適応と術式は、触知しない停留精巣7例(精巣固定術3例、Fowler-Stephen第I期の精巣血管結紮4例)、ヒルシュスプルング病5例(腹腔鏡補助下経肛門的引き下ろし術)、鎖肛3例(腹腔鏡補助下引き下ろし術)、性分化疾患3例(ヘルニア手術1例、性腺生検2例)、仙尾部奇形腫1例(骨盤内成分の腹腔鏡的授動と後方矢状切開による切除)、卵巣腫瘤2例(腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術)であった。男児14例、女児4例、性別不明3例。全例で開腹移行なく手術を完遂した。麻酔関連合併症や術後の人工呼吸管理は必要なかった。直接的な手術関連合併症はなかった。鎖肛の女児1例で直腸粘膜脱、ヒルシュスプルング病の1例で直腸膣瘻が生じたが、後者は人工肛門造設後に治癒した。各適応における腹腔鏡の主な利点は、骨盤深部の拡大視野とアクセス、ヒルシュスプルング病での早期の凍結切片生検、鎖肛での肛門形成位置の正確な設定、仙尾部奇形腫での早期血管結紮と開腹回避、停留精巣での血管の授動、曖昧性器での診断精度と治療の同時実施であった。結論：乳幼児の腹腔鏡下骨盤手術は安全で、拡大視野、アクセス性、整容性の利点がある。
